decision.reason: [ev-5a59843aa9b6] is a one-line release-note entry. It only says a "ManagedResourceDefinition one-pager" was added and links to PR 6577. It does not say what the one-pager is, whether it changes anything that ships in the product, or what it describes. With no subject, change, exposure condition or operational effect stated, the open aspects can't be written as a typed assertion without the PR or the document itself.
